content.comment_body: Is there a way to connect a [product_name] V8, acting as a motor controller, with a [version_no] system that has dual CPUs? How should switching between the two CPUs be managed?
The [product_name] supports Ethernet TCP/IP communication using either the S7 protocol or Modbus TCP/IP.

Hello, I don't have direct experience with the [version_no], but I've used the [version_no] and communication works in that setup. There is an example from [company_name] available on the [product_name] website, so it is likely possible for the [version_no] as well. You can use S7-Classic protocol over TCP/IP or Modbus TCP/IP. If the [version_no] includes an Ethernet interface and supports either protocol, integration should be feasible. Hope this information is helpful.
